note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Departments (sql/10_dimension_departments.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. RiskType 3 = Critical. Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Obligations this user is allowed to see, with their department (ComplianceInstance.DepartmentID).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID, s.RiskType, s.Imprisonment, ci.DepartmentID INTO #inst
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopedInstances(@UserID, @CustomerID) s JOIN ComplianceInstance ci ON ci.ID = s.ComplianceInstanceID;
-- Step 2. Keep only obligations with at least one due date inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
DELETE i FROM #inst i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso
WHERE cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
AND cso.ScheduleOn >= @WindowStart AND cso.ScheduleOn < @WindowEnd);
-- Step 3. Obligations overdue right now: past due and not closed, or never touched (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
SELECT DISTINCT o.ComplianceInstanceID INTO #ovd
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOverdueSchedules(@CustomerID, @AsOf) o
JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = o.ComplianceInstanceID;
-- Step 4. Obligations with a performer named on the obligation itself (ComplianceAssignment, RoleID 3).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#owned') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #owned;
SELECT ComplianceInstanceID INTO #owned
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOwnership(@UserID, @CustomerID) WHERE HasInstanceOwner = 1;
-- Step 5. The tenant's live departments (Department, not deleted).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dept') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dept;
SELECT d.ID AS DepartmentID, d.Name AS DepartmentName INTO #dept
FROM Department d WHERE d.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND d.IsDeleted = 0;

checks.name: All obligations in the report
checks.tables: Steps 1-2.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Obligations with a department (sum of all department rows)
checks.tables: DepartmentID points to a live department (step 5).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID;

checks.name: Obligations with no department
checks.tables: DepartmentID blank, or pointing to a deleted department. D2 + D3 = D1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID WHERE d.DepartmentID IS NULL;

checks.name: Share with no department (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.DepartmentID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID;

checks.name: Overdue obligations
checks.tables: Step 3. Live - can move between runs.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Overall overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / all obligations x 100.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value;

checks.name: Departments in the report
checks.tables: Every live department of the tenant (step 5), with or without work.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #dept;

checks.name: Departments that have obligations
checks.tables: Live departments with at least one obligation.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.DepartmentID) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID;

checks.name: Share of department work with no performer on the obligation itself (%)
checks.tables: Obligations in a live department not in step 4 / all obligations x 100.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID
LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL;

checks.name: A department's obligations
checks.tables: Obligations with this DepartmentID.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE DepartmentID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A department's overdue obligations
checks.tables: This department's obligations that are in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.DepartmentID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A department's overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / obligations x 100, for this department.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.DepartmentID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A department's obligations with no performer on the obligation itself
checks.tables: This department's obligations not in step 4. Most still have a performer on each due date (ComplianceScheduleOn.Performerid).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.DepartmentID = {RowKey} AND w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL;

checks.name: A department's share with no performer on the obligation itself (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.DepartmentID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A department's obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1, this department.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE DepartmentID = {RowKey} AND Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A department's Critical-risk obligations
checks.tables: Compliance.RiskType = 3 (Critical), this department.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE DepartmentID = {RowKey} AND RiskType = 3;

checks.name: People assigned to a department's obligations
checks.tables: Distinct ComplianceAssignment.UserID (any role) on this department's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.UserID) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.DepartmentID = {RowKey} AND ca.UserID > 0;

checks.name: Locations where a department has work
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this department's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE DepartmentID = {RowKey};

checks.name: Departments run by one person or fewer
checks.tables: Departments with obligations where P8 is 0 or 1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (
SELECT i.DepartmentID FROM #inst i JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID
LEFT JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID AND ca.UserID > 0
GROUP BY i.DepartmentID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.UserID) <= 1) x;

checks.name: Departments where 10% or more of work has no performer on the obligation itself
checks.tables: Departments with obligations where P5 is 10 or more.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (
SELECT i.DepartmentID FROM #inst i JOIN #dept d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID
LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
GROUP BY i.DepartmentID
HAVING CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) >= 10.0) x;
